info.title: MLivreTrabalho REST API
info.description: Contract of the currently implemented modular NestJS REST API. Opaque authenticated sessions, explicit tenant membership and transactional RLS remain the runtime authority. Schemas describe stable JSON cores and permit additional response fields; business rules and normalization are documented separately where JSON Schema cannot express them. Finance is simulated; verification providers, production operation, physical-device validation and independent pentest are not asserted. Preferences and general support without membership are not implemented. No production server is advertised.

parameters.description: Real authorized membership required. Optional owned reads aggregate the identity’s authorized scopes when omitted. For copilot/read it is mandatory for company tools; professional tools derive owned scope.

default.description: JSON error: invalid input/state, denied identity/role/membership, missing resource, conflict, throttle or unavailable dependency. Status and message remain the NestJS runtime contract.

session.description: Opaque 32-byte random base64url session token returned by signin, not JWT. Server stores its hash, enforces expiry/revocation and active identity. Never log the token.

webhookSignature.name: x-webhook-signature
webhookSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex of timestamp + dot + exact UTF-8 raw JSON body, optionally prefixed sha256=. Shared signing secret never belongs in the document.

webhookTimestamp.name: x-webhook-timestamp
webhookTimestamp.description: Unix seconds; freshness window 300 seconds in the existing internal adapter.

email.description: Trimmed, lowercased; resulting UTF-16 length 3..320, contains @ and no whitespace. This is the implemented validation, not RFC email validation.

workspaceName.description: Required for company; trimmed UTF-16 length 1..120. Ignored for professional.

email.description: Trimmed, lowercased; resulting UTF-16 length 3..320, contains @ and no whitespace. This is the implemented validation, not RFC email validation.

accessToken.description: Opaque session token, not JWT; returned only at login.

ProfileInput.description: Strings are trimmed; absent/null/blank optional fields become null.

AvailabilityInput.description: Explicit ISO date-time with Z or numeric offset, real calendar date, endsAt strictly after startsAt. Offset is accepted here; job publication requires canonical UTC Z.

CapabilitiesInput.description: Absent/null arrays default to []; duplicate strings are deduplicated. Every value must belong to the selected active taxonomy role; unknown skills/certifications are rejected.

JobInput.description: Real canonical UTC timestamps; endsAt > startsAt. Trimmed title and optional strings. Null/absent payCents becomes 0, engagementModality becomes gig; requiredRole defaults to title.

Coordinates.description: Optional body; non-null lat/lng must be supplied together. Coordinates are not a physical-presence verification.

inviteCode.description: Opaque single-use secret; do not log.

reason.description: Trimmed nonempty, maximum 1000 UTF-16 code units.

body.description: Trimmed nonempty; maximum 4000 Unicode code points.

TrustInput.description: Assignment required for no_show/late_arrival; if supplied it must belong to the professional. Cause defaults to undetermined.

reason.description: Trimmed nonempty; maximum 4000 UTF-16 code units.

anyOf.description: Optional nullable string; trimmed maximum 2000 UTF-16 code units.

description.description: Trimmed nonempty; maximum 4000 Unicode code points.

SupportInput.description: Requires real membership even with assignmentId null. Absent/null priority defaults to normal. General support without a membership is not implemented.

evidence.description: Trimmed nonempty; maximum 4000 Unicode code points.

text.description: Trimmed nonempty; maximum 2000 UTF-16 code units.

CopilotInterpretInput.description: Mode defaults to assisted. Current provider is deterministic; no critical action is executed automatically.

CopilotReadInput.description: Tool allowlist depends on memberships/account type. Company tools require x-tenant-id plus membership. Professional tools derive their owned scope. Read-only, explicit invocation.

PrivacyRequestInput.description: Trimmed details <=2000 UTF-16 code units; nonempty required for correction/restriction/objection/automated_decision_review. Request is submitted for processing, not automatically fulfilled.

VerificationCase.description: Requests create/reuse pending cases. No real KYC/KYB provider approval is asserted.

PaymentEventInput.description: Signed synthetic/internal event. Payout event types additionally require recipientProfessionalId matching the assignment. Same key+facts replays; changed facts conflict. This is not a real PSP integration.
